subject: RetailGen POC - request for short-term capacity escrow (overnight ramp)
messages:

Cc: eng-team@retailgen.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RetailGen POC - short-term capacity ask for overnight ramp

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the KV cache behavior. We're ready to run a focused overnight ramp to validate p95 and p99 under 30k qps for our recommender service.

Request: a temporary capacity escrow / credit top-up sufficient for a 12-hour overnight soak (estimated 10M tokens). We attached our load plan and an initial SOW draft.

Constraints:
- Start window: 2026-08-10 00:00 UTC (preferred)
- We need read-only logs and p95/p99 token-level latency traces for the run
- No data residency changes; this is still on hosted account

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a promo credit or ephemeral capacity for this run? If there is any paperwork we should sign, share it and we'll expedite.

Best,
Amina Patel
Head of Platform
RetailGen

Attachments: retailgen_loadplan.xlsx, sow-draft.pdf

From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RetailGen POC - short-term capacity ask for overnight ramp

Hi Amina — thanks for the load plan.

We can support a 12-hour soak; a couple of quick clarifications before I route this for approval:
1) Do you need dedicated GPU pools (reserved) for the window, or would a hosted promo credit (allowing burst) be acceptable?
2) Confirm the exact token estimate (you listed ~10M — is that the ceiling or expected consumption?)
3) For traces: we can provide token-level latency breakdowns and per-route dashboards, but full debug logs will require a signed data access addendum.

Tech has flagged an optimization we recommend for the run (quantized v2 + kv prefix caching) — tagging @karthik for a quick feasibility check.

If this is time-sensitive, we can provision a provisional sandbox top-up (72h rollback window) once Marissa signs off on the promo.

Next steps: if you reply with the tokens ceiling and whether burst credits are fine, I'll assemble the approval packet and DocuSign the minimal SOW addendum.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RetailGen POC - short-term capacity ask for overnight ramp

Jonas / Marissa — quick technical note:

I reviewed the attached load plan. The reported 30k qps for the recommender with 1.2k avg seq length looks plausible with our dedicated profile, but to hit p99 under the requested ceiling we should do the following at provisioning time:
- Use quantized V2 profile for the model; reduces per-token GPU time by ~18% in our benchmarks
- Enable continuous KV prefix caching and set max_batch_latency to 12ms for this run (keeps latency SLO tight while batching benefits persist)
- Provision ephemeral dedicated slots (not shared) for the 12-hour window to avoid noisy neighbor variance

From an infra budget perspective, if RetailGen confirms a hard ceiling of 10M tokens we can estimate credits and present a single promo invoice. If they want burst on hosted we should include a fall-back cap to avoid runaway cost.

I can generate the config snippet for the run; Jonas — if you want I can attach it to the approval packet.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: RetailGen POC - short-term capacity ask for overnight ramp

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding RetailGen's ask (see attachments). Summary: 12-hour overnight soak, ~10M token ceiling, request for either promo hosted credits or ephemeral dedicated slots. Tech (Karthik) recommends dedicated ephemeral slots + quantized profile for stability.

Why I need sign-off: this would be a one-off promo credit / capacity escrow. RetailGen is mid-market, strong likelihood to convert to a paid dedicated commitment after the validation. Proposed ask: one-time promo credit covering the 12-hour run (estimate attached) AND a 72-hour rollback window.

Can we approve a small promotional budget (internal cap $12k USD) for this? If yes I will prepare the DocuSign SOW addendum and attach the config Karthik prepares.

Thanks — quick yes/no appreciated so I can lock windows with their team.
Jonas
